mode: Built-in image_gen; 3 separate transparent full repaint edits
shop: Use case: style-transfer. FULL REPAINT / REDRAW of entire first image into the illustration language of second image. First input is architectural composition and identity reference ONLY; do NOT retain its glossy 3D render style. Second input is the strict master art direction reference: serene clean hand-painted storybook fantasy map, matte surfaces, soft daylight ambient illumination, restrained natural color, clear painted shapes. Repaint every roof, wood beam, stone, metal fitting, prop, character, and foliage in this same calm illustrated visual language. Rich meaningful detail through clean defined shapes, NO shiny gold microtexture, NO harsh black contour outlines, NO HDR, NO heavy beveling, NO lacquer highlights, NO photorealistic noise. Contrast and saturation align with the map. Wood becomes soft natural mid-brown, stone muted cool slate-gray, greens muted sage/moss/teal. Foliage consists of clear individual pointed leaves overlapping in graceful clusters with modest shape shading, never puffy generic bush blobs, never blurred. Lighting is diffuse daylight across exterior with a small restrained warm glow in lamps/interior; no blasting orange gold illumination across all surfaces. Preserve first input's complete architectural identity, main objects, camera perspective, silhouette and footprint, object placements, relative sizes, and exact blank signboard positions and shapes so UI labels still fit. Real transparent alpha background, no scene, no checkerboard, no pale fringe, no white outline, no ground shadow disc. Retain natural shallow grounded base from first image, no giant added platform, dangling cliff, or extra island. No words, lettering or watermark. The whole asset must look painted by the same artist as reference 2, not simply recolored. Keep output full asset uncut with 6-pixel-equivalent clear margins. Subject: same mushroom potion shop as image 1. Preserve red/coral mushroom cap roof and its small blue roof window, both blank wooden signboards (top center and bottom center), red/cream striped awning, friendly silver-haired blue-eyed catgirl behind counter with small white and green cat next to her, shelves with colorful potion glassware, lanterns, wood door, barrel, tiny flowers. Characters retain identity and appealing expressive faces but are clean softly painted rather than shiny 3D. Colorful potions and coral mushroom remain readable accents in a restrained harmonious scene palette. Original canvas ratio 502:510.
